g.text: a) 注意图示的极性和位置
b) 使用磁棒拾取并放置钕磁铁
（4 个北极磁铁 + 4 个南极磁铁）
c) 确保磁铁牢固就位
d) 注意不要悬停在刚安装的磁铁上方，
a) Pay attention to polarity and location as shown in drawings
b) Use Magnet bar to pick and place the Neodymium magnets
c) Make sure the Magnets are well-seated
d) Pay attention not to hover over the recently installed Magnets
